rich_narrative.summary: The Institute for Social Policy and Understanding (ISPU) is a research-driven organization that provides objective data and analysis about American Muslims. Since its <cite id="1">founding in 2002</cite>, ISPU has worked to educate the general public and equip community leaders with evidence-based insights. The organization maintains <cite id="2">strong financial health</cite>, evidenced by a <cite id="3">98.25/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite>. In FY2024, the organization reported <cite id="4">total revenue of $1,454,023</cite>, which represented a <cite id="5">decline from $1,624,938 in FY2023</cite>. Despite this recent revenue dip, the charity remains stable with <cite id="6">22.6 months of working capital</cite> available to sustain its research operations. ISPU operates as a capacity-building entity, focusing on <cite id="7">programs like the American Muslim Poll</cite> and Muslims for American Progress. These initiatives aim to reach <cite id="8">millions of people</cite> through media and policy dialogue. For Muslim donors, the organization <cite id="9">accepts zakat-eligible donations</cite> specifically for its research work under the category of fisabilillah. While the organization is highly transparent, its <cite id="10">program expense ratio of 72.9%</cite> is slightly below the 75% industry benchmark. This reflects the intensive nature of high-quality research and the costs associated with maintaining a <cite id="11">13-member board of directors</cite> and professional staff.
